assessment: A-level tool-first page for "http status checker" (210/mo, KD 12): the HTTP Status Checker is the first screen, the 51-word answer resolves the query directly, and the body answers "http status check" with first-hand AEOeye measurements before handing off to the free SEO audit.

topic.readerProblem: Someone searching "http status checker" wants to run the check immediately and know what the result means for their site.
topic.connection: The free SEO audit runs this check site-wide (crawlability, on-page, speed, schema, HTTPS); this page is the single-URL version and links into it.

sources.supports: Google follows up to 10 redirect hops; 4xx except 429 treated the same; 429 and 5xx slow crawling; soft 404.
Reference definitions of HTTP status codes.
AEOeye 391-site baseline: redirects, headers, meta tags, OG/X tags, icons, JSON-LD, image formats, blog location, soft 404s.
